newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telmex raised to buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said Monday it had raised its rating on Telefonos de Mexico, or Telmex, to buy from hold.
-- Analysts Luanne Zurlo and Trey Vincent wrote in a report, "Telmex is finally going places in 1997, and we believe this direction is up.

"We raise our rating to buy based on a 21 percent real local service rate increase, announced December 27, imminent market share loss clarification, compelling valuation, and positive momentum after two years of doldrums."
-- Zurlo and Vincent set a 12- to 18-month price target of $45 for the company's American Depositary Receipt, which was up 1-1/2 to 34-7/8 in New York.
